requirement: `habeas status` and the mdBook requirements index MUST generate their Definition/Evidence Markdown tables through the same renderer. That renderer MUST calculate column widths, align the columns, and display the same evidence-state labels in both outputs. Callers MAY select different definitions and supply different kind-labeled name cells so mdBook can link to detail pages.
rationale:
I found no gaps. The one thing I did not check is that a non-ASCII name could misalign a column, because the renderer measures bytes but pads by characters. The requirement doesn't name that case.

**Obligations and code**
- **Same renderer for both outputs.** `habeas status` and the mdBook index both call `render_evidence_table` in `src/markdown.rs`. `src/commands.rs#fn[status_markdown_with_github]` calls it, and it is reached from the marked `src/commands.rs#fn[status_markdown_with_options]`. `src/index.rs#impl[DetailPlan]/fn[populate]` calls it directly and carries its own `{impl}` mark.
- **Calculate column widths and align the columns.** `render_evidence_table` takes the maximum cell width for each column, with the header text as the minimum. It then pads every header, separator and data row to those widths with `{:<width$}`.
- **Same evidence-state labels in both outputs.** `status_markdown_with_github` and `populate` both fill the second cell with `evidence.state().label()`.
- **Callers MAY select different definitions and supply different name cells.** This is optional, so nothing needs checking. The code does it anyway. The CLI passes `` `name` (noun) `` cells for glob- and state-filtered definitions. `populate` passes `` [`name`](href) (noun) `` cells so mdBook can link to detail pages.

**Tests**
- `tests/commands.rs#fn[status_tables_align_each_column_to_its_widest_cell]` runs `habeas status` with and without `--all`. It checks that the pipe positions match on every row and that each column is as wide as its widest cell. It also checks the `Valid`, `Missing`, `Determination false` and `Invalid` labels.
- `src/index.rs#mod[tests]/fn[index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters]` checks the same four labels in the mdBook index. It also checks the pipe alignment and column widths, and the link-style name cells.
- Together the two tests cover both outputs.
